title: scleria lithosperma

It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from coughs, colds, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory effects. The health benefits of Scleria lithosperma include its ability to soothe the digestive system, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms associated with bronchitis and asthma.
